rachel_fin: FYI -- planning a small A/B on the high-throughput SKU. Variant = +12% unit price. Grandfather opt-in for customers with invoices >90 days. Draft price CSV in Drive: https://drive.company/fin/price-experiments/sku-high-apr.csv

mike_ops: Ops asks: exclude reserved contracts, limit variant to accounts <6M tokens/mo, and add a soft QPS cap for 7 days. Also want an automatic rollback if billing delta >0.75% in 24h.

omar_product: Cohort strategy: 80% treatment / 20% control for new signups. Auto-grandfather for legacy paid customers older than 90 days unless they opt out. Sales can request exceptions.

jena_eng: Tech notes: billing supports per-customer rate_override. Backfill job will issue prorated credit for remainder of current billing period only. We'll mark accounts lacking invoice snapshots as MANUAL_REVIEW. Dry-run planned: 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z.

lucy_sales: Sales needs a Console flag "grandfathered:true" and a simple exceptions workflow (Zendesk ticket + spreadsheet). 48h SLA preferred. We'll prep copy for rep FAQ.

billingbot: Snapshot check: coverage = 95.8%. Missing snapshots: acct_314, acct_827. Run archive_check --ids acct_314,acct_827.

rachel_fin: Good. Finance position: no retro credits on closed invoices; only prorated current period. Manual disputes -> RevOps escalation.

jena_eng: Confirmed: credits computed per billing_entity_id. We'll emit a CSV of MANUAL_REVIEW accounts after dry-run for ops to handle.

omar_product: Approvals required: finance sign-off on credit policy, legal on messaging/TOS, eng + product on rollout plan. Target signoff by Fri COB; publish next Wed.

mike_ops: I'll post routing + capacity gating in #eng-infra today.

rachel_fin: Thanks all 5. Tagging @legal @revops. Will post final publish note here once approvals are in.
